topic: Someone discovers their partner has been writing a novel about them
text: I stumbled upon it by accident, really. There, on the kitchen table, a stack of papers neatly bound. Curiosity took over, and I began to read. It was me, on every page, in a form I hadn't expected. Words that painted a picture of our life together, but through a lens I hadn't seen before. I can't help but wonder what this means, if it’s a good thing or if I'm overthinking it. Part of me wants to talk about it, to understand his perspective, but another part of me is unsure where to start or what I might find out.
